description: Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government - Notice under Section 51 of the Minutes on Pensions, Amended Extraordinary Gazette No. 2310/07 Dated 12.12.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification amends pension regulations regarding compulsory retirement ages for specific categories of medical and dental officers. It deals with public service retirement benefits and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) covering "Pension and retirement benefits" and "Service conditions and benefits" for public sector employees. While it mentions a minister's name, this is only in the signature block and does not involve detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger Types 1-3.
